headline: President Bush updated an earlier executive order so it matches the 2003 law renewing the federal anti-human-trafficking program.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 13257, which set up a group of federal agencies to work together against human trafficking. The changes are meant to carry out the Trafficking Victims Protection Reauthorization Act of 2003, which renewed and updated the federal anti-trafficking law. No summary was provided, so the exact changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work on human trafficking
who_it_affects.how: The order updates the rules for how these agencies coordinate their work under the 2003 law.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 18, 2004; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided information.
